pages.text: The Athame obtains special drops from eligible creatures killed with a direct strike. Hearts, Ectoplasm and other materials unlock further witchcraft. Carry empty glass bottles in your offhand to collect blood from eligible victims.

The Boline is used for plant harvesting, including Spanish Moss. It can shear supported plants, but moss specifically requires a Boline: ordinary shears do not collect it. Terminal moss tips do not drop an item.
